notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Dying Light: The Beast" or "Dying Light The Beast". dyinglight.fandom.com answers the API under "Dying Light: The Beast", with only about 15 linked pages, including "Locations in Dying Light: The Beast", "Kyle Crane" and "Blueprints (Dying Light: The Beast)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 3008130 is "Dying Light: The Beast". 16 of 42 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter, together with the visible "Complete the main story". Restored Land Mode has six achievements with very low unlock rates (about 1 to 3%). RAWG lists an average playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low for this game.
